name: VFWF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top title, offered as the prize for surviving The Gauntlet; a former handler's own closure testimonial recalls Allen "The Acer" Carter as a former one-time champion. No dated title match survives in the held record.

name: VFWF Internet Championship
epitaph: Recalled by a former handler's own closure testimonial as a title Allen "The Acer" Carter held for the whole of the fed's run ("All Time VFWF Internet Champion"). No dated title match survives in the held record.
